summary: First iteration backend testing for Allô Québec. Wrote pytest suite covering 15 tests across root/guides/auth/reminders/chat. ALL 15 TESTS PASSED. Critical LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent Universal Key) integration works end-to-end: French reply returned, multi-turn history persisted in MongoDB and replayed, sessions and messages retrievable.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 on create; acceptable but inconsistent with REST conventions.
Sets cookie with secure=True and samesite='none' (correct for cross-site preview), but client must use Bearer header in tools that don't support partitioned cookies — fine.
Model id 'claude-sonnet-4-6' is hardcoded; works via emergentintegrations. Consider exposing via env if model needs to be swapped.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: history replay concatenates a 'Historique récent' text block into a single UserMessage rather than using LlmChat's native message list — functional but suboptimal token usage; consider sending real prior messages.
server.py: /api/auth/session uses cookie samesite='none' + secure=True; OK for the preview domain. Make sure frontend uses fetch with credentials:'include'.
server.py: ReminderCreate.due_date is a plain string with no ISO validation; consider pydantic.datetime or validator.
server.py: get_current_user does not check if expires_at exists/parses safely for all session shapes — minor.
server.py is a single 590-line file; still manageable but trending toward needing modularization (auth/, chat/, guides/, reminders/).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id':0}. Good.
test_credentials: Created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md. Session token: test_session_1780642472979, user_id: test-user-1780642472979 (stored in test_database). Token expires in 7 days.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test user and 1 user_session in MongoDB for Bearer-token auth. Guides auto-seeded by backend on startup (8 guides present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test session token `test_session_1780642472979` is valid for 7 days. Run: TEST_SESSION_TOKEN=<token> pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. To regenerate: see /app/auth_testing.md. Frontend testing not done in this iteration.
